description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget that extends TextView and implements the LogNode interface. It formats and displays log messages received through the println method, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, formatting messages and optionally chaining to the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and Throwable information, then outputs it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log string as a new line in the LogView.
